description: Search Monster Hunter World monsters by name, species, or size class. Returns species classification, elements, ailments, and weaknesses to plan hunts.

limit.description: Maximum number of monsters to return. Defaults to 20.

name.description: Filter by monster name (case-insensitive substring), e.g. "nergigante".

species.description: Filter by species. One of: elder dragon, flying wyvern, brute wyvern, bird wyvern, fanged wyvern, piscine wyvern, fanged beast, neopteron, herbivore, wingdrake, relict, fish.

name: get_monsters

total_matched.description: Monsters matching the filters before the limit cut.

total_monsters.description: Total monsters in the MHW database.

title: Get Monsters
